apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). About $0.001 for a default 256 MB run.

geocode-result.eventDescription: Charged once per SUCCESSFUL forward (address → lat/lng) or reverse (lat/lng → address) geocode returned by your provider and saved to the dataset. Alternatives (limit > 1) are included at no extra cost. Not charged: missing key, REQUEST_DENIED / 401 / 403, 429 after retries, ZERO_RESULTS / not found, invalid input, timeouts.

matrix-element.eventDescription: Optional. Charged once per SUCCESSFUL Google Distance Matrix origin→destination element (status OK) when enableDistanceMatrix is on. Elements with NOT_FOUND / ZERO_RESULTS or failed requests are free.
